notes.title: The game from the creators of hack_me and hack_me 2 has been released!
notes.content:
Project DeepWeb is a deep web exploration simulator. Puzzles are on the surface, but answers are deep inside. You're going to discover hundreds of websites, find dozens of documents, go through every Internet level — it's all to achieve your objective. And if you're brave enough to dig a little deeper, you'll see something, that was supposed to stay intact forever.
Order Project DeepWeb today!

notes.title: New project - 30 Seconds To Jail
notes.content:
Guys, we are happy to announce our new project - 30 Seconds To Jail!

30 seconds to jail is an indie game about a dude, who gets a bag of drugs. You have 30 seconds to figure out how to get rid of them and not get caught in jail. From banal feeding to the dog, to the full rituals of calling the spirit of Bob Marley.

If you want to help 30 Seconds To Jail for free, follow the link and support us on Thunderclap:
https://www.thunderclap.it/projects/69680-30-seconds-to-jail

This service makes 1 post from your account in social networks, which helps spread the game to most people.

Also you can add our game to your wishlist:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/817770/30_Seconds_To_Jail/

Thank you for your support ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: hack_me out of the early access!
notes.content:
Here came the long-awaited moment of me: hack_me out of the early access!

The game has a little more than 2 months, during which time much of the game changed.
Were added 2 chapter, fixed dozens of bugs (I think here there are players since the first version, where it was impossible to pass on the message '0'), a lot of features were added by the help of community.
But there is still a lot of work: adding chapters 4 and 5 - and it's only a fraction of all that needs to be done.

Thanks to everyone who was with us all the time and helped to make the game better!
